notes.notes:
Bug fix

 Visual post process bug in black room.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.01
notes.notes:
Bug fix

 Remove the unsupported Mixed reality button in the options menu for players with a Quest 3 headset.

notes.title: Character Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Introducing Wilhelm "The Ice" Berg

 New character, level and achievements


Performance improvements

 Update game to the latest Unreal engine version 5.4.4.
 Optimizations to lights and shadows in Levels and texture sizes for better performance when playing wirelessly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2.1 Improved Support For Small player Areas
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Improved opponent distance management and movement. 

The opponents will now stay more within reach if outside of the player bounds.

Fixes Coach mits Minigame spawn location.

The coach sometimes spawned above ground.

Optimized graphics for better performance.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes


 Counterfist Clay and Riley the Rockets normal punches no longer deal damage on successful blocks by the player.
  Improved force feedback on collisions
 Larger help texts.
 Hooks should be easier to land during the tutorial.


Bug Fixes


 Catlike and Turtle stance achievements are now unlockable.
 Leaderboards are gathered quicker and displays private account scores too.
 Force feedback no longer loops endlessly after power punches are interrupted at any timing.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
Features


 Subtitles: Togglable subtitles during tips and tutorials.


Changes

Game menu button is now available also on:


   Quest: Y button
   Vive: Trackpad Up
   Valve: B button


Bug Fixes


 Fast knockdowns reducing opponent health regeneration
 Game menu button not working properly when using SteamVR.
 Duke's power punch requiring less drastic, more appropriate dodges.


Known Issues


 Leader-boards not displaying private player high-scores.
